title: Senior Product Manager – Open Banking APIs
description:
We build API products that regulated banks expose to third-party providers. As Senior Product Manager you take over a product line with three partner banks live and five more onboarding.

What you'll do
- Drive the roadmap for our account-information and payment-initiation APIs
- Run discovery with partner banks and fintech developers; synthesise findings into priorities
- Work with engineering leads on scope, sequencing and release decisions
- Mentor two junior product managers and report adoption metrics to the leadership team

What you bring
- 6+ years in product management or product ownership, at least 3 in payments or open banking
- Strong understanding of REST APIs, PSD2 and strong customer authentication
- Evidence-based prioritisation; comfortable with SQL and product analytics
- Excellent English
